name: setting-row-radio
title: SettingRowRadio
description: Padded settings-row composition for an editable Radio group and its non-interactive saved-value readout.

intent.summary: Padded settings-row composition for an editable Radio group and its non-interactive saved-value readout.
useWhen: A settings card needs a mutually exclusive Radio group as one padded row item.
The same settings card needs to display the saved option without an interactive control in view mode.
avoidWhen: The Radio group is not part of a settings-row surface; compose ds-radio directly.
The setting is a single immediate on/off choice; use component:ds-setting-row-toggle.
accessibility: In edit presentation, slot exactly one ds-radio group and give it a visible label or an explicit aria-label/aria-labelledby.
Keep the Radio group's options, value, required state, and selection event owned by the application.
Do not add a second interaction layer to the row; Radio owns option focus and keyboard selection while settings usage keeps hasInteractionFill false.
View presentation exposes readable label, saved value, and optional supporting copy without radio semantics or a focus target.
states: The row is a neutral padded composition; selected, focus, and inactive states belong to the slotted Radio without a choice-list hover or pressed wash.
The owning application handles dsChange and updates the slotted Radio value.
View presentation replaces the control with the saved option label and retains consequence copy when it helps explain that choice.
responsiveBehavior: The row never exceeds its parent width; the slotted Radio keeps its option copy in the flexible column and wraps descriptions when needed.

styling.rationale: The row owns only settings-list padding and width containment; Radio owns control geometry and interaction treatment.

protected.reason: Preserve the settings-row inset when a Radio group is placed in a CardSetting body.

description.description: Optional consequence or supporting copy for the saved option.

label.description: Label shown above the saved value in view presentation.

presentation.description: Interactive Radio group or non-interactive saved-value readout.

valueLabel.description: Saved option label shown in view presentation.
